title: Sampling by transforming uniform numbers
summary: Turn uniform random numbers into exponential, normal and categorical samples with the inverse CDF, the Box-Muller transform and a cumulative search.

mutants.exponential_uses_u: Uses -log(u) and not -log(1 - u), so u = 0 gives infinity.
mutants.exponential_missing_rate: Does not divide by the rate.
mutants.box_muller_variance: Uses -ln u1 and not -2 ln u1 in the radius, so the variance is 1/2.
mutants.categorical_left_boundary: Puts a u that equals a cumulative value into the earlier category and can pick a category with probability 0.
mutants.categorical_no_cap: Does not cap the index, so rounding can give an index outside the list.
